name: Fabricators Supply
old_description: Fabricators Supply, LLC, is a full line steel service center based in West Point, MS. We offer our clients a large inventory, reliable service and competitive pricing. Our central location enables us to offer next-day shipping on most orders throughout the Southeast. Customers nationwide appreciate us for our processing capabilities and short lead times.
about:
Fabricators Supply, LLC operates as a full-line steel service center from West Point, Mississippi. The company is American owned and operated, emphasizing domestic steel sourcing. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The business maintains a large inventory that includes structural tube — described as one of the largest tube inventories in the United States — along with channels, flats, angles, sheet, and plate. Processing services cover plasma cutting with bevel capabilities on material up to three inches thick and 10 by 60 feet in size, plus painting, small fabrication, and miter cutting. Part sizes can reach 10 by 21.5 feet.

Customers nationwide draw on the company’s stock and processing, with next-day shipping available on most orders throughout the Southeast. The central Mississippi location supports short lead times for fabricators, manufacturers, and construction projects across the region.

Fabricators Supply highlights its American ownership and domestic steel supply as a key differentiator, alongside a broad product range, competitive pricing, and the ability to deliver processed material quickly from a single source.
